message:
I think I'm going to assign this post to my freshmen.  We've been watching and discussing the various techniques in the Obama/McCain ads, and of course, Senator McCain's military service comes up, as do discussions of Viet Nam and Iraq.  Your post will help widen their perspective on the military.

BTW--watching the ad videos is much like playing the believing/doubting game for me.  I try to mask, or at the very least, point out, my own political leanings even as we critique both sides.
